prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-human-figure.png. Requested dimensions 2048x3072, 2:3. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
1 · Human — homeworld Sol — accent steel-blue
Game role: the diplomats and traders; the "friendly" default. Strengths: expert traders (trade treaties pay more), magnificent diplomats (everyone starts friendly, Council votes count extra), cheap force-field science. Weakness: no martial, production, growth or spy edge — they win by deals and shields.
Body & dress: ordinary human variety; the approved leader is a weathered 50-something admiral-diplomat. Deep navy naval-style uniform, silver braid, discreet insignia; civilian formal wear for audiences (dark tailored coats, a small comm-pin). Never overtly militaristic.
Surroundings: an orbital capital: warm-lit wood-and-steel offices, trade-hall mezzanines, big windows onto Earth-blue planetlight, commodity tickers, ship models, treaty tables with brass fittings. Pragmatic, comfortable, a little worn.
Personality: charming, shrewd, amused, quietly tough. Moods: warm-genial → polite-wary → cold-courteous.
Hooks: a diplomat's pouch of gifts, mismatched souvenirs from many alien courts, a chess-like board game left mid-play.
Asset purpose: Full-body race leader. EXACT SAME individual, face, species, coloring, collar insignia and uniform design as reference, extended into full formal dress with accurate species anatomy including wings or tail where applicable. Dignified iconic pose, 2-3 small culturally telling props.
Composition: CRITICAL: use a plain nearly black studio background with only a faint dim floor, NO detailed room, NO planet window, NO furniture. Entire leader standing three-quarter view, head to feet fully visible uncropped with generous margin. Lower 15% quiet. Soft subtle floor reflection. Easy silhouette for later cutout; not transparent.
Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
